def: properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in votive obligation

occurrences.text: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men which have a vow on them;
And the prayer of faith shall save the sick, and the Lord shall raise him up; and if he have committed sins, they shall be forgiven him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
